title.en: US directs Anthropic to restrict Fable 5 and Mythos 5 access
title.zhHans: 美国要求 Anthropic 限制 Fable 5 与 Mythos 5 的访问

searchSummary.en: A June 12 export-control directive to Anthropic led it to suspend access to both models for all users. The directive’s broader legal effect remains disputed.
searchSummary.zhHans: 6 月 12 日针对 Anthropic 的出口管制指令使其暂停所有用户对两款模型的访问。该指令更广泛的法律效力仍有争议。

summary.en: On June 12, 2026, Anthropic said it received a US Commerce Department directive requiring restrictions on foreign nationals’ access to Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5. Unable to verify users’ nationality in real time, Anthropic suspended access for all users. The company reported receiving the directive at 5:21 p.m. ET; this was not a timestamp for the completion of the shutdown. Later legal analysis described a company-specific licensing letter and disputed the legal basis for treating remote model access as an export. No reviewed source establishes that this action caused Z.ai to release GLM-5.2 weights.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 6 月 12 日，Anthropic 表示收到美国商务部指令，要求限制外国国民访问 Claude Fable 5 与 Mythos 5。由于无法实时核验用户国籍，Anthropic 暂停了所有用户的访问。公司称美东时间下午 5:21 收到指令；这不是停用完成的时间戳。后续法律分析将该指令描述为针对特定公司的许可要求函，并对将远程模型访问视为出口的法律依据提出质疑。已核阅来源不能证明该措施促使 Z.ai 发布 GLM-5.2 权重。

narrative.en: Anthropic launched Fable 5 for broader access and Mythos 5 for selected partners on June 9. On June 12 it stated that it had received a Commerce Department export-control directive at 5:21 p.m. ET, and that it was removing access to both models for all users because it could not reliably distinguish foreign nationals in real time. Its later account says access had been suspended. The Department’s letter itself is not in this evidence packet. Mayer Brown described the June 12 action as a company-specific “is informed” licensing letter under the Export Administration Regulations. Legal commentary questioned whether remotely querying a hosted model amounts to exporting the model; no generally applicable restriction on other developers was established in the material reviewed. Fable 5 first-party access was reported restored on July 1. The GLM-5.2 weight repository has a June 16 file snapshot, but proximity alone cannot establish that the directive caused that release.
narrative.zhHans: Anthropic 于 6 月 9 日向较广泛用户推出 Fable 5，并向选定合作方提供 Mythos 5。6 月 12 日，公司称于美东时间下午 5:21 收到商务部出口管制指令；由于无法可靠地实时区分外国国民，正向所有用户移除两款模型的访问权限。其后续说明称访问已暂停。本证据包没有指令原件。Mayer Brown 将 6 月 12 日的措施描述为依《出口管理条例》发出的、针对特定公司的“知会”许可要求函。法律评论质疑远程调用托管模型是否构成模型出口；所查材料未证明该措施对其他开发商确立了普遍适用的限制。据公司后续公告，Fable 5 第一方访问于 7 月 1 日恢复。GLM-5.2 权重仓库有 6 月 16 日的文件快照，但时间接近不能证明这项指令促成了其发布。

text.en: Anthropic said it received a Commerce Department export-control directive on June 12 requiring restricted foreign-national access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5.
text.zhHans: Anthropic 称 6 月 12 日收到商务部出口管制指令，要求限制外国国民访问 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5。

text.en: Anthropic reported receiving the directive at 5:21 p.m. ET; it subsequently suspended access to both models for all users because it could not verify nationality in real time. The exact time suspension finished is not established.
text.zhHans: Anthropic 称于美东时间下午 5:21 收到指令；因无法实时核验国籍，随后暂停所有用户访问两款模型。停用完成的确切时间尚未证实。

text.en: The licensing letter was directed at Anthropic; legal commentary disputes whether hosted-model access qualifies as an export and does not establish a general restriction on other developers.
text.zhHans: 许可要求函针对 Anthropic；法律评论质疑托管模型访问是否构成出口，且未证实该措施普遍约束其他开发商。

text.en: Anthropic suspended access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5 for its users after the June 12 directive; its July 1 update confirmed first-party access to Fable 5 had been restored. This records a service-access interruption, not a lasting industry-wide precedent.
text.zhHans: 6 月 12 日指令后，Anthropic 暂停用户访问 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5；其 7 月 1 日更新确认 Fable 5 第一方访问已恢复。这记录的是服务访问中断，而非已经确立的长期行业先例。
